name: Model & Agent Fingerprinting
description: Probing a live AI system to identify the model family, its ontology and guardrails, the shape of its outputs, its artefacts and its hallucination profile — the reconnaissance that makes targeted prompts reliable.
differs: Distinguished from System Prompt & Configuration Disclosure (T5.001), which extracts the actual configuration; fingerprinting infers properties from behaviour.
